verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an inference API, and a platform like this could plausibly offer background automations, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no product-native way to set up autonomous or scheduled automations. The Batch API only runs one-off asynchronous request groups, which is not a recurring or autonomous automation, and tool calling is a building block developers would orchestrate themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
